_comment: Skills delivered to Paperclip seats as company catalog skills. slug: path relative to $HOME. The Platform Engineer's instrument sweep re-imports any entry whose file changed since the revision recorded on its card; the original is the file, the catalog copy is the delivery. Every path here is checked by scripts/validate_skills.py (E7) — 4 of these 7 were silently broken on 2026-09-30 by the plugin rename (plugins/deliberate -> plugins/j-deliberate) and by the vault moving from ~/Documents/pkm to ~/dev/pkm.
